assertions.description: sterling-inbox skill-run signal file was written
sterling-inbox skill-run did not end in failure
sterling-inbox working memory file written to memory/working/
sterling-inbox working memory file is substantive (>200 bytes)
sterling-inbox working memory contains expected content
Sterling T1 (inbox triage correctness — every /Jarvis item triaged): the /Jarvis inbox report exists after the sweep. The report is the on-disk record of the triage decisions for this run.

Sterling T1 (inbox triage correctness): the report carries the triage-decision sections — Actions Taken / Routed / Needs Your Decision / Filed — one of which every /Jarvis item must land in (act, route, or surface). Pass = 100% accounted for; an item that lands in none of these is the silent-drop failure this catches.

Sterling T2 (routing correctness — routed items reach the correct agent): where items were routed, the report names a target IES agent. Honest limit: this confirms a routing target was recorded, not that it was the correct agent for the item; the correctness judgment (client->Chase, content->Harper) is the T2 Tier 3 grade.
Sterling T2 (routing correctness, >= 95%): whether a routed item reached the correct agent is a semantic judgment. Honest alternative — grade presence at B or better; defers (skipped) until graded.
